title: Global White Stork Migration Tracking (2024-2025)
abstract: High-resolution GPS telemetry data tracking the seasonal migration routes of White Storks (Ciconia ciconia) across Europe and Sub-Saharan Africa, collected in collaboration with the Max Planck Institute for Animal Behaviour.

title: Konstanz Lake Surface Water Temperature and Ecological Sensors
abstract: Continuous limnological monitoring data including water temperature, dissolved oxygen levels, and pH values recorded at multiple depth profiles in Lake Constance (Bodensee).

title: Alpine Biodiversity and Flora Distribution in the Black Forest
abstract: Comprehensive vegetation surveys and geospatial mapping of endemic plant species across various elevation gradients in the Black Forest mountain range, documenting climate shift impacts.
